note: Б19 (found by seed 12, fixed in 1.51.0): format(3, 2, {}) over four astral characters. yjs walks the range for empty attributes too and splits the items at its ends; both ends fall inside a surrogate pair, so the halves become U+FFFD (the split halves merge back at commit with that content, and no update event is emitted). ygo returned early for empty attributes and kept the characters.
